pcs.pc_description: check the new service requests on daily basis and corresponding job cards
plan work on requests (service or repair) according to the schedule and location of the service (at customer site, on road or in workshop)
prioritize the service or repair requirements for vehicles reported with respect to technician, spare parts allocation, etc.
perform workshop load calculation to plan daily operations and their execution in a smooth manner
allocate technicians/component specialists as per the requirements of the service, maintenance or repair to be done on the vehicle

modules.module_title: Manage tools, equipment and procurement of spare parts

pcs.pc_description: manage day to day troubleshooting of various components in coordination with technical specialists
ensure that the equipment and special tools are used in the correct manner by the technicians/component specialists as per the OEM guidelines
manage the maintenance of workshop facilities and other tools including fixed equipment
coordinate with the spare parts manager to ensure supply of materials, parts and other requirements
ensure procurement of spare parts from the market in the most cost-effective manner which are not available at workshop spares counter and urgently required

develop solutions for identified faults and issues in the various components/aggregates of the vehicle
plan the optimised processes at the various bays (including AMC bay, quick repair bay etc.) of the workshop to ensure smooth operations
ensure that the placement of vehicles on the designated bays are scheduled for quick service/repair
assist team in resolving critical issues that need urgent action or specialist intervention
ensure that the complaints, service and repair requirements by the customer is resolved to his/her satisfaction and within estimated time and cost
manage quality issues in the work done by the technicians and components/aggregate specialists to reduce rework or repeat complaints
provide appropriate personal protective equipment to all people working on the bays of the workshop and encourage them to use it for promoting a safe working environment
perform the final inspection after the service and repair operations are completed, in case the quality inspector is unavailable
prepare all diagnostic and repair reports in coordination with components specialists and technical manager
